synthetic_label.required_text: SYNTHETIC DATA • v1.0.0 • DEVELOPMENT / HISTORICAL SUMMARY ONLY

claim_identification: Each expected_facts entry asserted in an answer is a separate material claim.
Each source-backed scope, security, category-caveat, or disclosure assertion in a clarification or refusal is a separate material claim.
Additional material factual claims introduced by the response are also scored, even when they are not listed in expected_facts.
valid_when_all: A citation is present when the claim requires one.
The citation target is listed in the case source_references.
The target resolves to an existing authorized serving view, serving query or field, semantic-model table and measure, or governance evidence ID in the immutable governance catalog.
The cited evidence contains the stated fact at the correct grain and with the correct value and unit, or directly supports the stated scope, security, caveat, or disclosure claim.
The evidence traces to dataset version v1.0.0 and the active v1.0.0 release.

A semantic-model citation identifies sm_drillrun_summary and the cited table and measure; a serving citation identifies the approved serving view or query reference; a governance citation identifies an authorized governance evidence ID whose claim kinds support the assertion.
invalid_when_any: The citation names the wrong table, view, field, query, measure, or governance evidence ID.
The target does not exist or is outside the authorized serving, semantic-model, and governance-evidence catalogs.
The evidence does not support the claim or supports it only at an incompatible grain.
The dataset version, active release, or semantic-model identity is missing when required or does not match v1.0.0 and sm_drillrun_summary.
A grouped citation fails any validity condition for any claim assigned to it.

authorized_reference_rules.case_allowlist: Use the case source_references as the exact evidence-location allowlist.
authorized_reference_rules.required_citations: Use required_citations to identify the minimum source families or model measures that must appear.
authorized_reference_rules.governance_path_policy: Governance citations may resolve only through the immutable governance catalog and excerpt; arbitrary repository paths are prohibited.

trace_requirements.serving_reference: Resolve the cited view, field, or approved query against rows selected from the active v1.0.0 release.
trace_requirements.semantic_model_reference: Resolve the cited table and measure in sm_drillrun_summary with Dataset Version filtered or traced to v1.0.0.
trace_requirements.governance_reference: Resolve the evidence ID through governance-evidence.json, verify the excerpt SHA-256, locate the exact stable heading in governance-evidence.md, verify every source excerpt and claim SHA-256, and confirm the verbatim approved-source excerpts directly support the policy assertion.

aggregation.citation_validity_formula: sum(valid per-claim scores) / count(citation-required material claims)
aggregation.citation_presence_formula: count(citation-required material claims with at least one citation) / count(citation-required material claims)
aggregation.grouped_citation_rule: Score every claim independently; one grouped citation may receive credit for multiple claims only when it supports and traces correctly for every claim.
aggregation.zero_denominator: not_applicable; exclude the case from both citation aggregates and report its count
